metric: share of CAUTION hours where g_o is at the maximum
rationale: g_o(small) fires 6851 times vs g_r 250 and g_w 0. Expect g_o to account for the overwhelming majority of daylight CAUTION.

metric: share of non-SAFE hours where g_r is at the maximum
rationale: g_r fires 264 times total across 5 years (250 CAUTION + 14 UNSAFE).

metric: share of non-SAFE hours where g_t is at the maximum
rationale: Night is 11 of 24 hours; g_t already observed at 20097 UNSAFE activations.

metric: number of distinct functions ever observed at the maximum
rationale: g_w cannot bind (P01); g_m has no data so cannot bind. Effective classifier is g_o + g_r + g_t.
g_t alone produces 3 scheduled transitions per day x 1827 days = 5481. Remainder from g_o and g_r.

metric: non-time-driven transitions (g_t unchanged across the transition)
rationale: Wave height changes on an hourly-to-multi-hour timescale; boundary crossings should be infrequent.

metric: A->B->A oscillations within 3 hours, excluding time-driven
rationale: Genuine chattering. Predicted rare because wave height is smooth at hourly resolution.

metric: percentage reduction in non-time-driven transitions from dual-threshold hysteresis
rationale: Benefit expected real but modest. Wide band because this is the least well-grounded prediction here.

metric: is mode-chattering a demonstrated deployment problem at this site?
rationale: Headline prediction: hysteresis is a precaution rather than a demonstrated necessity. Both papers currently assert mode-chattering as a deployment concern without evidence. If P10/P11 hold that claim needs softening.

metric: does the architecture reduce empirically to a vessel-conditional wave gate plus night curfew?
rationale: Follows from P05+P06+P07+P01. Framing consequence: a five-function classifier where two functions never bind and one is unmeasured. Predicted now so it cannot be explained away afterwards.
actual: g_o 97.5% daylight CAUTION; g_t 88.2% all non-SAFE; g_w & g_m never bind

rationale: Expect sea-cell wind to cross 22 kn occasionally - enough to make g_w alive, not enough to dominate. If it stays at 0, F-1 is a real property of the site and Q1 is settled. If it exceeds 500, the v1 data was badly wrong.

metric: MFWAM (8km) CAUTION rate vs ERA5-Ocean (50km) over same period
rationale: 8km resolves island sheltering (Tunku Abdul Rahman group) that a 50km cell averages away. Boats operate inside that shelter. DIRECTIONAL PREDICTION - if MFWAM comes in HIGHER the nearshore-sheltering reasoning in F-12 is wrong and the direction-of-error argument must be revisited.
notes: ERA5 16.4pct vs MFWAM 11.3pct CAUTION. Models correlate r=0.953 on 28501 valid pairs; MFWAM mean 8.5pct lower and max much lower (1.84 vs 2.60 m). MFWAM never reaches small-vessel UNSAFE (1.9 m).

metric: Level 2 binding rate under MFWAM wave data
rationale: Follows from P17. If the headline figure is resolution-sensitive this quantifies by how much, which is otherwise an open flank for a reviewer.
